notes: Two reports, both narrow, so the fourth step of the README produces something you can read rather than a wall of output.

'metric_max_age_seconds' is the freshness gate: a measurement older than this is not reported. It matters more than it looks - without it a report restates yesterday's numbers as though they were current, which is worse than reporting nothing.
'report_base_url' is empty because nothing is serving the rendered pages here. The reports are still written under runtime/reports; the URL only decides what link a delivered message carries.
